children: Saudi Arabia's Al Rajhi Bank has priced a $600 million Tier 2 social sukuk at a profit rate of 6.232%.
The Regulation S issuance was priced at UST +170bps, tightening from IPTs in the UST +200 area.
The transaction garnered final order books of more than $1.25 billion (ex JLM), having peaked at over $1.85 billion.
The sukuk carries a 10.5-year maturity with a non-call period of 5.25 years and was issued at par.
The securities will be listed on the London Stock Exchange's International Securities Market (ISM).
Tier 2 sukuk are commonly used by banks to strengthen their regulatory capital base and support future growth.
(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Al Rajhi Bank prices a $600mln Tier 2 social sukuk
